newsitem.title: USA: Hilton Hotels pinpoints ITT board slate.
newsitem.headline: Hilton Hotels pinpoints ITT board slate.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp on Wednesday named the 11 people it planned to nominate to replace ITT Corp's board of directors when it comes up for re-election at ITT's next annual meeting.
In a Securities and Exchange Commission filing, Hilton also said it intended to offer two resolutions for shareholder vote at the meeting.

The first asks shareholders to repeal each provision of ITT's bylaws that was adopted on or after July 23. The second asks them to urge ITT management to accept Hilton's offer or take any action necessary to permit the proposed merger.
A Hilton spokeswoman said July 23 was the most recent date on which ITT had changed its corporate bylaws.

The filing follows Hilton's unveiling on Tuesday of a list of 25 potential nominees to ITT's board. Hilton had said it would offer 11 of the names as a replacement slate to ITT's current board. The remaining 14 would be added if ITT attempted to boost the number of its board members as a defense against Hilton's $6.5 billion hostile takeover bid.
Earlier Wednesday, ITT rejected Hilton's offer, saying it was not in the best interest of its shareholders. ITT has not scheduled its next shareholder meeting.
1) Daniel J. Altobello, Potomac, Md., chairman of the board of ONEX Food Services Inc and former chairman of the board, president and chief executive officer of Caterair International Corp.
2) George N. Aronoff, Cleveland, Ohio, partner of the law firm of Benesch, Friedlander, Coplan & Aronoff.
3) Scott H. Bice, Pasadena, Calif., dean of University of Southern California Law School.
4) James J. Florio, Piscataway, N.J., partner of law firm of Florio & Perrucci P.C., and a former governor of New Jersey.
5) Fred D. Gibson Jr, Las Vegas, chairman, president and chief executive officer of American Pacific Corp.
6) Dianne Jett, Las Vegas, a former president of Sprint-Central Telephone Co of Nevada.

7) Robert S. Kingsley, Far Hills, N.J., a private investor and a former president and chief operating officer of HFS Gaming Corp., and a former president and chief operating officer of Caesars World Resorts Inc.
8) Aubrey C. Lewis, Montclair, N.J., a former vice president of Woolworth Corp.
9) Celeste Pinto McLain, Los Angeles, a private attorney and arbitrator, and a board member of National Railroad Passenger Corp (Amtrak).
10) Gilbert L. Shelton, Marshall, Va., a private investor.
11) Warren C. Woo, Bethesda, Md., president of corporate development at Snyder Communications Inc.
